changelog:
- Initial release of picgo-skill for uploading local images via the local PicGo service API.
- Supports uploading one or multiple images at once.
- Allows configuration of PicGo service address using the PICGO_SERVER_URL environment variable.
- Includes usage examples and setup instructions.
- Requires the requests Python package.
- Timeout for requests is set to 30 seconds.
